content.summary: Casey Tran (TUTOR) reports an audio playback problem on task AUD-741 in Firefox 132: the audio played the first time, but after dragging the waveform back to the start the sound stops and the time display stays at 0:00. Riley Chen (QA_TUTOR) asks for the task ID and browser build, saying a second reproduction is needed before filing. Casey replies with AUD-741 and Firefox 132.0.2, adding that reopening the task restores playback until the next seek. The thread contains no diagnosis, fix, or handling decision, and the report does not pose an explicit question or request a decision.

attributed_agent1_resolution.rationale: The root is a symptom report with no explicit question or requested decision (no preference, severity, label, or action is asked for), so there is no central question to preserve. The only reply is an evidence request (task ID, browser build, and a second reproduction before filing), which is diagnostic and does not establish an answer. Casey's follow-up supplies the requested details and a workaround observation (reopening restores playback until the next seek) but no cause, fix, or handling decision. No message supplies a substantive conclusion, and no TEAM_LEAD endorsement or eligible author exists, so the thread remains unresolved.
attributed_agent1_resolution.note: Agent 1 label, not evidence; NEEDS_REVIEW means Agent 1 did not verify it. Assess resolution from the member messages.

content.note: Agent 1 interpretation, not source evidence; cite member messages for incident facts.

content.summary: Drew Kim (TUTOR) reports an endless spinner after using jump-back on task AUD-768 in Firefox 132.0.2, noting that playback had already worked before the jump-back. Drew asks whether anyone else is seeing it. Avery Lin (TEAM_LEAD) replies asking Drew to keep the affected task open and to add browser and task details to a single report. No one else confirms the issue, and no cause or fix is stated.
